title: The 8 Best World Cup Sneakers
text:
Take a look through Footwear News' selection of the best 2026 World Cup sneakers, including releases from Nike, Adidas and more.
KidSuper and Bape's 48-country Sta capsule and Patta's Nike Cryoshot Mercurial R9 are two of this year's best World Cup sneakers. With soccer’s influence on sneakers and fashion at-large growing over the past few years, it should come as no surprise that theReleases tied to the sport’s pinnacle event started popping up early in the year and have building with more frequency as Thursday’s opening game has drawn closer.
Through collaborations and in-line efforts, all the major brands have been tossing out options to rep futbol on-foot throughout the summer. This colorful Air Jordan 3 was made to match the Jordan away kit and has a spirit befitting “o jogo bonito.

One of the clear highlights is Palace’s more obscure choice of the first shoe to break into the top flight of English football in the late-’80s. Patta opted for a crowd-pleaser with Ronaldo’s Mercurial R9 and made it its own with Dutch orange accents to rep its home country.
Y-3 and Adidas have been mixing football and fashion long before most, and for the 2006 World Cup they dropped a four pack of limited-edition boots featuring different beasts. 20 years later, they’ve returned with their studs trimmed to a level suited for everyday wear.
